title: Receipt branch in outbox_tick uses continue, not separate function
description: The receipt delivery logic (lines 932-973 in kith-peer/src/lib.rs) uses continue to skip message-specific code rather than extracting a separate function. Correct because: receipts and messages have fundamentally different validation and payloads; continue makes control flow crystal clear (handle receipt, skip message logic); avoids function parameter explosion; keeps lock acquisition points explicit. Alternative: separate function rejected because would obfuscate bypassing all message-specific loading.
